annotations.title: Link to buy a package or membership

description: The packages and memberships a place sells online, and the link where the person pays for them. Only for places whose owner turned it on. You cannot pay for them: they open the link and pay on the place's own secure Stripe page. Gift cards aren't sold through this tool: if the person asks, say they can buy one from the place's own page (join_link) when the place sells them.
